h1: AI lives here, not on a server

ctas.text: Check it against the committed model

firstScreen.text: AI lives here, not on a server This page runs the committed model in your browser — the same numbers the published bundle was generated with — and assembles the evidence an attestation would carry. Nothing is fetched to run it, nothing is sent anywhere, and no key is involved: a signature is an identity claim, and a page has no identity. What you get is the PROOF, which anyone can recompute. Seed Steps Run the committed model here Ran here in 3 ms. The replay agrees — this output is the committed model's, and anyone can recompute it. alphaalphadeltaalphaalphagammaalphagammadeltadeltagammadelta
